correctness.rationale: For a selected vertex in part i, the number of outside neighbors is exactly q-c_i. Thus certified domination is equivalent to domination plus q-c_i not equal to 1 for every selected part. The domination polynomial is elementary. For q at least 2, a half-shadowed event for part i is exactly a complement with k in-part omissions and one omission outside; pairwise event intersections occur only for a two-vertex complement with one omission in each of two non-singleton parts. No triple intersection occurs. Exhaustive definition-level testing checks 128 isomorphism types and 64,916 subsets through order ten.
